title: Lasted about two days :P
text: Lasted about two days :P. lasted like two days then the color started to rub off and my cat is using it as a scratching mat, so it's practically dead I'm just keeping it on the table to protect from the cat and as we eat but it's just a giant shower cap it requires two persons to put it on the table... It's thick though it won't tear easily i gotta give it some credit. It's an item that you have to replace every once in a while like toilet seat covers and such.

features: Ideal for pedestal or four-legged tables, these wipe-clean tablecloths are elasticized for a smooth, snug, no-slide fit.
Weatherproof vinyl with soft backing makes them perfect for outdoor use also.
Round fits tables up to 48" in diameter.
Oval fits tables up to 68" long.
Rectangle fits tables from 58" to 68" long.Available in patterns: Ivy (IVY), Blue Floral (BLU), Hydrangea (HYD), Multi Fruit (MUL), Mauve Floral (MAU), Beige Floral (BGE) or Green Floral (GRN)..
